title: Ask the agent about a row (Discuss)
done: That is it: the row is marked, and the agent answers it when its current step ends.

steps.caption: Each row is something the agent did. You can ask about exactly that row.
Right-click a row to see what you can do with it.
Discuss marks the row for the agent, without a message from you.
The count shows your open requests. The agent answers each when its current step ends.
Your turn: double-click a step of the plan to discuss it.
